//: Your Herdr board rules. Every list here is ADDED to the package's defaults (~/.claude/veroboard/defaults.json); blocked.disable switches built-in rules off by id (ids: top of ~/.claude/veroboard/rules.js). Changes apply on each agent's next status-line run.

people.//names: Only these people count as someone an agent waits on ('Blocked · Luke'). Empty: any capitalized name does. Agents (t22) always count. Example: ["Luke", "Sam"]
people.//notPeople: Tools, bots and models: 'waiting on Devin' is background work, not a person. Example: ["Devin", "Jenkins"]

blocked.//asks: Phrases near the end of an agent's message that mean it waits for you (Blocked · You). Example: ["your thoughts"]
blocked.//notAsks: Phrases that make a sentence not an ask. Example: ["just FYI"]
blocked.//nothingForYou: Phrases that say you have nothing to do: never Blocked · You. Example: ["all quiet on your side"]
blocked.//todoLabels: Line-start labels that hand you a to-do. Example: ["action item"] for 'Action item: rotate the key'
blocked.//disable: Built-in rule ids to switch off. Example: ["paste", "question"]

board.//: How the board looks (Board settings → Display). Leave a setting out to use the package default: cables true, cablesThroughCards 5, contextRamp [50, 85], stuckMinutes 15, glow true, greyWhenSeen true, doneTimer true, activeRing true.
board.//card: What each card shows and where (Board settings → Card). Easiest to set in the dialog. Shape: {"lines": [{"left": [], "right": []} ×3], "hidden": [], "rows": true}; badge ids: laneTime, why, launched, address, openedBy (hidden by default), folder, branch, model, effort, window, space, context.
board.//top: The top bar (Board settings → Board). Shape: {"lines": [{"left": [], "right": []}], "hidden": []}; item ids: spaces, newSpace, count, pie, divider, gear (can't be hidden), filter.
